query: On NCS 25.11 CN-B (BareMetal), a worker node went NotReady right after the NCS upgrade. kubelet is up but the node stays NotReady. What are the likely causes and how do I fix it?
followup: CN-B bare-metal, affected node role is worker, it happened during the upgrade phase.

query: NCS 25.7 upgrade fails in the leapp upgrade with sqlite3.OperationalError: unable to open database file. How do I fix it?
followup: CN-B bare-metal, on the controller/master node, during the OS upgrade (leapp) phase.

query: On NCS 25.7, WorkerBM nodes have an unsorted multipath route going through the EdgeBM nodes. How is this corrected?
followup: CN-B bare-metal, worker and edge nodes, day-2 operation.

query: On NCS 24.11, resume fails during the Ceph upgrade because Ceph is not OK. What should I do?
followup: Storage nodes, during the upgrade phase; Ceph reports it is not healthy so resume will not continue.
